hook: Your retainer ran out. Did the client know?

tips.title: Agree on hours up front
tips.body: Set the monthly hours before work starts, so nobody guesses.

tips.title: Log work as you go
tips.body: Small notes the same day beat a long list at the end of the month.

tips.title: Let the client look anytime
tips.body: A page they can open beats a status email they have to wait for.

outro.caption: Retain shows clients a live progress bar.

voiceover: Your retainer ran out. Did the client know?
Agree on the monthly hours before work starts.
Log your work the same day you do it.
Give the client a page they can check anytime.
Retain shows them a live progress bar for the retainer.

post.caption: Most retainer arguments start with a surprise. A shared progress bar takes the surprise out. How do you show clients their hours?
